plainTranslation: Their Mars in your 12th house: their drive stirs your hidden side - desire you don't fully understand, or buried anger surfacing. Failure mode: passive conflict, hidden resentment, indirect action. Bring the energy and the friction into the open; don't let it run underground.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry house overlay material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
